about: Every release, newest first, and what it changed on each side: the scanner and the server (PLAN.md D197, D217; the server was the home before 1.2.0, D225 -- the key stays "home", which every scanner since 1.1.1 reads). versions.py reads it, and the help site builds its page of every version from it.

scanner.zh: 安装时分别问要不要在桌面、开始菜单放快捷方式；「连接服务器」的快捷方式只在你说要时才放
scanner.en: setup asks about the Desktop and the Start menu one at a time; a Connect server shortcut only if you say yes

scanner.zh: Mac 也能放快捷方式：桌面和「应用程序」（启动台、聚焦搜索都找得到）
scanner.en: shortcuts on a Mac too: on the Desktop and in Applications, where Launchpad and Spotlight find them

scanner.zh: 新的「5 卸载 Uninstall」：去掉快捷方式和程序，先问扫描记录和设置要不要一起删（默认留下）
scanner.en: a new 5 卸载 Uninstall: removes the shortcuts and the program, and asks first whether your scans and settings go too (they stay unless you say yes)

home.zh: 网页里的物品图标改用 WebP：库存页的图标从 15.6 MB 变成 4.0 MB，打开更快；发给扫描端的图鉴仍是 PNG
home.en: the pages' item icons are WebP: the inventory's icons go from 15.6 MB to 4.0 MB and open faster; the catalogue sent to scanners stays PNG

scanner.zh: 修复：扫描开始前出现 database is locked，wuwa live 无法扫描
scanner.en: fixed: wuwa live stopped before scanning with "database is locked"

scanner.zh: 修复：保存的 wuwa-home 改名成 wuwa-server 后扫描器无法开始；现在会自动跟上新名字，找不到服务器时就先在本机扫描，下次再发送
scanner.en: fixed: a saved wuwa-home renamed to wuwa-server stopped the scanner; it now follows the new name, and with no server found it scans on its own and sends the scans next time

scanner.zh: 主机改叫服务器：「2 连接服务器 Connect server」、wuwa server set、server.key；旧的 wuwa home 和 home.key 照样能用
scanner.en: the home is now the server: 2 连接服务器 Connect server, wuwa server set, server.key; the old wuwa home and home.key still work

scanner.zh: 连接服务器时地址直接按回车：先找 wuwa-server，再找以前的 wuwa-home
scanner.en: Enter at the server's address tries wuwa-server, then the older wuwa-home

scanner.zh: 安装最后可以在桌面和开始菜单放快捷方式（Windows）：WuWa Scan、WuWa Dashboard
scanner.en: setup can put shortcuts on the Desktop and in the Start menu (Windows): WuWa Scan, WuWa Dashboard

scanner.zh: Mac 程序包带图文指南 START-HERE.html
scanner.en: the Mac packages carry a picture guide, START-HERE.html

home.zh: 主机改叫服务器：镜像叫 wuwa-inventory-vision-server（旧名字照样更新）；钥匙复制成 server.key，home.key 留着
home.en: the home is now the server: the image is wuwa-inventory-vision-server (the old name keeps updating); the key is copied to server.key, home.key kept

home.zh: 「更新 › 数据 › 版本」只列最新的和正在用的版本，全部版本在帮助网站
home.en: Update › Data › Versions lists the newest and the versions in use; every version is on the help site

scanner.zh: 连接服务器时钥匙那一步直接按回车：从「下载」文件夹里拿最新的 server.key（NAS 打不开 .key 文件也没关系）
scanner.en: Connect server takes the key from Downloads when you press Enter: the newest server.key there (for a NAS that cannot open .key files)

home.zh: 服务器的网络由一个更新永远不会换掉的小容器拿着，NAS 的「更新」不再报 No such container（要先粘贴新的配置文件一次）
home.en: the server's network is held by a tiny container no update replaces, so the NAS app's update no longer fails with No such container (paste the new compose file once)

home.zh: 图标统一成一套：所在的页显示实心图标，鼠标停上去各有动画；总览换成指南针
home.en: one family of icons: the page you are on shows its icon solid, each moves on hover; Overview is a compass

home.zh: 手机上商店的价格和底数是格子自己的底栏；版本列表分开写扫描端和服务器改了什么
home.en: on a phone a shop tile's price and base are its own foot; the version list shows what each side changed, and what to update

home.zh: 折叠屏和 300 像素宽的手机上，帮助、商店、我的共鸣者、版本列表和「这是谁」都排得整齐
home.en: on a folded phone and screens 300 px wide, Help, Shops, My resonators, the version list and "Who is this?" read right

home.zh: 下拉列表不会被会滚动的列表挡住；逐个命名悬停时不再变暗；数据页两个方块之间有间距
home.en: a dropdown is never cut off by a list that scrolls; Name them one by one no longer dims under the pointer; the Data page's two boxes have a gap

scanner.zh: 连接服务器时比较两边的版本，说哪边该更新、缺什么
scanner.en: compares versions with the server, and says which side to update and why

scanner.zh: 服务器比较新时，双击「4 更新 Update」自己更新
scanner.en: updates itself with 4 更新 Update when the server is newer

scanner.zh: Mac 版程序包（mac-full、mac-scanner）
scanner.en: packages for a Mac (mac-full, mac-scanner)

scanner.zh: 认得超级豹风雪；奇幻变奏不再没有名字；一模一样的物品不再拿来学习
scanner.en: 超级豹风雪 is named; 奇幻变奏 is no longer left unnamed; items drawn exactly alike are not learned

home.zh: 总览说最新的扫描是哪个版本的扫描端做的；更新页列出每个版本改了哪边
home.en: Overview says which scanner version made the newest scans; Update lists what each version changed on which side

home.zh: 待确认的物品说它可能是哪几样，而不是说它们长得一模一样
home.en: an item waiting to be confirmed says what it could be, not that the candidates look identical

home.zh: 第一次下载图鉴快了几倍；钱包每种货币取各自最新的读数
home.en: the first catalogue download is several times faster; each wallet amount is its own newest reading

home.zh: 快速连点共鸣者进度会合起来保存；共鸣者和武器默认显示已拥有
home.en: quick clicks on a resonator's progress are saved together; Resonators and Weapons open on Owned

home.zh: 识别不列一模一样的物品，说明也改清楚了
home.en: Recognition leaves out items drawn exactly alike, and says better what it is

scanner.zh: 特殊料理不再认成原料理（青蔬蛋饼）
scanner.en: special dishes are told from their base dish (青蔬蛋饼)

scanner.zh: 颜色挡掉了正确的图时改为待确认（千古洑流、气动阻抗喷雾）
scanner.en: a tile whose right picture was shut out on colour waits for a click (千古洑流, 气动阻抗喷雾)

scanner.zh: 数量相同的两个标签页不再合并；新物品第一次扫描就认识
scanner.en: two tabs with the same count are kept apart; new items are known on the first scan

scanner.zh: 扫描页显示还没扫描的标签；连接服务器只要 wuwa-home
scanner.en: the scan page shows the tabs not scanned yet; connecting takes just wuwa-home

home.zh: 现成的 Docker 镜像；新服务器在引导最后下载图鉴，显示进度和剩余时间，失败自动重试
home.en: a ready-made Docker image; a new server downloads its catalogue at the end of the guide, with progress, time left and retries

home.zh: 批量标记已练满一次完成，进行中有提示
home.en: marking many resonators is one quick save that says it is working

scanner.zh: 维基更新后的新物品第一次扫描就认识
scanner.en: new items from a wiki update are known on the first scan

home.zh: 总览显示商店位置和低于目标的材料；待确认一键找到；规划成为日常页
home.en: Overview shows where shops are and materials below target; items to confirm are found in one click; Planner is a daily page

scanner.zh: 第一个公开版本
scanner.en: the first public release
